title: Boox teases the incredibly tiny Picco ereader - Engadget
summary: Boox did tell us that this is the first product in a brand-new category of "e-paper devices with diverse form factors." The company already makes e-paper tablets and e-paper displays , so we aren't sure what form factors are left.
